_doc: ARC §8.1 M4 LIVE take 2 (real sim hearts): as ui-m4.json (harsh recipe until fearful), then a calm day, one lightning, and the camera on the densest knot of outdoor fear/fist-signed people at 120 m (M4) and 45 m (pose check), UI on; then the Hearts layer on the live (unstubbed) heart at 1500 m. Run: setsid nohup _harness/slot.sh node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/arc-work/specs/ui-m4b.json --port=5311 > _harness/scratch/arc/shots-m4b.log 2>&1 &

shots.name: arc-m4b-120
script: G.hold('ui'); document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); const t0 = performance.now();
await G.cmd({ k: 'set', path: 'disasters.natural', value: 0 });
const r0 = await G.cmd({ k: 'life.spawn-people', species: 'plains-folk', count: 45, era: 'bronze', settled: true, wildGame: false });
const sid = r0.created.find((e) => e.kind === 'settlement').id; window.__sid = sid; const pv = () => window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.vis.pv;
const pos0 = () => pv().settlements.find((s) => s.id === sid)?.pos;
let h = null, days = 0;

for (days = 0; days < 160; days++) { if (days % 4 === 1) { const p = pos0(); if (p) { await G.cmd({ k: 'miracle.storm', pos: [...p], radius: 350, wrath: 0.3 }); await G.cmd({ k: 'miracle.lightning', pos: [...p], wrath: 0.3 }); } } await G.step(1440); const hs = (await G.query('hearts', { settlement: sid })) ?? []; h = Array.isArray(hs) ? hs[0] : hs; if (h && h.kind === 'fearful' && days % 4 >= 2) break; }
window.__h = h; await G.step(1440 + 600); const p = pos0(); await G.cmd({ k: 'miracle.lightning', pos: [...p], wrath: 0.3 }); await G.step(30); await G.frames(2);
const A = pv().agents, R = pv().ground?.radius ?? 3000; const sig = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]; const out = [];

for (let i = 0; i < A.count; i++) { const s = A.heart ? A.heart[i] : 0; sig[s]++; const shel = A.flags2 ? (A.flags2[i] & 2) : 0; if ((s === 2 || s === 3) && !shel && !(A.flags[i] & 256)) out.push(i); }

let best = -1, bn = -1; for (const i of out) { let n = 0; for (const j of out) { const d = Math.acos(Math.min(1, A.pos[i*3]*A.pos[j*3] + A.pos[i*3+1]*A.pos[j*3+1] + A.pos[i*3+2]*A.pos[j*3+2])) * R; if (d < 40) n++; } if (n > bn) { bn = n; best = i; } }
window.__aid = best >= 0 ? A.id[best] : null; const tgt = window.__aid != null ? { kind: 'agent', id: window.__aid } : { kind: 'settlement', id: sid };
G.hold(false); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: tgt, dist: 120, tilt: 60, yaw: 30, fov: 50, hour: 10 }); await G.frames(4); G.hold(true);
const vis = G.agents(80).map((a) => { const i = [...A.id].indexOf(a.id); return A.heart ? A.heart[i] : 0; }); const vc = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]; for (const s of vis) vc[s]++;

return { days, secs: Math.round((performance.now() - t0) / 1000), heart: h && { kind: h.kind, fearful: h.fearful, caption: h.caption }, signsAll: sig, outdoorFearFist: out.length, knot: bn, onScreen: vis.length, onScreenSigns: { fist: vc[2], fear: vc[3], pray: vc[1], none: vc[0] }, crowds: window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.vis.life.crowds.stats };

shots.name: arc-m4b-45
script: const tgt = window.__aid != null ? { kind: 'agent', id: window.__aid } : { kind: 'settlement', id: window.__sid };
G.hold(false); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: tgt, dist: 45, tilt: 66, yaw: 30, fov: 50, hour: 10 }); await G.frames(4); G.hold(true);

const A = window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.vis.pv.agents; const vis = G.agents(80).map((a) => { const i = [...A.id].indexOf(a.id); return A.heart ? A.heart[i] : 0; }); const vc = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]; for (const s of vis) vc[s]++;
return { onScreen: vis.length, fist: vc[2], fear: vc[3] };

shots.name: arc-m4b-layer
script: G.ui_.overlay('hearts'); G.hold(false); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: { kind: 'settlement', id: window.__sid }, dist: 1500, tilt: 50, yaw: 30, fov: 50, hour: 11 }); await G.frames(4); G.hold(true);
return { legend: document.querySelector('.gn-legend')?.textContent?.slice(0, 120) };
